_comment: EXAMPLE labels tied to ONE specific video library (the maintainer's) — the video names below will NOT exist in your library, so REPLACE these cases with your own. Format: query -> expected video name(s). expect_top: that name must be the #1 result. expect_in: all listed names must appear in results. enhanced toggles cross-modal search. Add ~12 queries you can eyeball-verify; keep only labels you are sure are correct. The harness (eval_search.py) is generic and works with any labels file via --labels.
